records.title: Lemmings
records.current_rights_assessment: Sony Interactive Entertainment Europe rights route; Exient is current licensed mobile publisher, not established owner
notes: Original Amiga Lemmings was developed by DMA Design and published by Psygnosis.
Current trademark evidence lists Sony Interactive Entertainment Europe Limited as owner.
Exient describes Lemmings as Sony IP and currently publishes the mobile title under license.
Original game binary/data remains proprietary.

correction_log.claim: Exient acquired the Lemmings IP from Sony
correction_log.corrected_claim: Sony Interactive Entertainment Europe remains evidenced as trademark owner; Exient is a current licensee/publisher for Lemmings mobile.
correction_log.reason: Primary/stronger evidence contradicted the preliminary hypothesis.

key_findings: Shadow of the Beast has a strong current Sony rights route: Sony Interactive Entertainment publishes the 2016 reimagining and asserts trademark rights.
Lemmings also has a strong Sony rights route. Exient currently publishes the mobile game under license; it should not be modeled as owner based on current evidence.
Psygnosis/Sony corporate succession is research evidence, not automatic proof that Sony owns every game Psygnosis ever published.
Titles developed by third parties but published by Psygnosis require separate chain-of-title research.
RGME should add explicit claim lifecycle states so retracted/superseded rights hypotheses remain auditable rather than silently overwritten.
